tools.name: hookdeck_list_connections
tools.description: List connections that link a source to a destination, with their rules and pause/disable state. Good first call to see what the project routes. Hookdeck API: GET /connections.

tools.name: hookdeck_get_connection
tools.description: Get one connection by id: its source, destination, rules, and paused_at or disabled_at state. Hookdeck API: GET /connections/{id}.

tools.name: hookdeck_list_sources
tools.description: List inbound sources: the URLs that receive webhooks from other services, with type and disabled state. Hookdeck API: GET /sources.

tools.name: hookdeck_get_source
tools.description: Get one source by id: its URL, type, and disabled state. Hookdeck API: GET /sources/{id}.

tools.name: hookdeck_list_destinations
tools.description: List outbound destinations: the URLs or services that Hookdeck delivers events to, with type and disabled state. Hookdeck API: GET /destinations.

tools.name: hookdeck_get_destination
tools.description: Get one destination by id: its type, config and disabled state. This tool does not request the auth config. Hookdeck API: GET /destinations/{id}.

tools.name: hookdeck_list_events
tools.description: List events (one per delivery to one destination) with status, attempts, response status and next attempt time. Use status=FAILED to find deliveries that need attention. Hookdeck API: GET /events.

tools.name: hookdeck_get_event
tools.description: Get one event by id: its status, destination, attempt count, last and next attempt times, and last response status. Hookdeck API: GET /events/{id}.

tools.name: hookdeck_retry_event
tools.description: Retry delivery of one event to its destination now. This sends the payload again to the customer's endpoint, so use it only for an event the user chose to resend. Hookdeck API: POST /events/{id}/retry.

tools.name: hookdeck_list_requests
tools.description: List inbound requests: each webhook call Hookdeck received at a source, with accepted or rejected status and the event count it created. Hookdeck API: GET /requests.

tools.name: hookdeck_get_request
tools.description: Get one inbound request by id: its source, verification result, rejection cause and event count. Hookdeck API: GET /requests/{id}.

tools.name: hookdeck_list_attempts
tools.description: List delivery attempts: each HTTP call Hookdeck made to a destination, with method, URL, response status and latency. Filter by event_id to see one event's history. Hookdeck API: GET /attempts.

tools.name: hookdeck_get_attempt
tools.description: Get one delivery attempt by id: requested URL, method, response status, error code and timing. Hookdeck API: GET /attempts/{id}.

tools.name: hookdeck_list_issues
tools.description: List issues: grouped failures (delivery, transformation, backpressure or request) that need a person to look. Filter by status=OPENED for the open ones. Hookdeck API: GET /issues.

tools.name: hookdeck_get_issue
tools.description: Get one issue by id with its type, status and details. Hookdeck API: GET /issues/{id}.

tools.name: hookdeck_list_transformations
tools.description: List transformations: the small JavaScript functions that reshape or filter events in flight. Hookdeck API: GET /transformations.

tools.name: hookdeck_get_transformation
tools.description: Get one transformation by id with its code and environment variable names. Hookdeck API: GET /transformations/{id}.

tools.name: hookdeck_pause_connection
tools.description: Pause a connection: Hookdeck stops delivering new events on it and queues them until it is unpaused. Reversible with hookdeck_unpause_connection. Hookdeck API: PUT /connections/{id}/pause.

tools.name: hookdeck_unpause_connection
tools.description: Resume a paused connection so Hookdeck delivers its queued events again. Hookdeck API: PUT /connections/{id}/unpause.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "hookdeck_get_transformation" references sensitive artifacts (environment variable). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Get one transformation by id with its code and environment variable names. Hookdeck API: GET /transformations/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hookdeck_list_sources, hookdeck_get_source, hookdeck_list_destinations, hookdeck_list_attempts, hookdeck_get_attempt, hookdeck_list_issues, hookdeck_get_issue · Private data: hookdeck_get_transformation · Public sink: hookdeck_retry_event, hookdeck_list_requests.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hookdeck_list_sources, hookdeck_get_source, hookdeck_list_destinations, hookdeck_list_attempts, hookdeck_get_attempt, hookdeck_list_issues, hookdeck_get_issue · Private data: hookdeck_get_transformation · Public sink: hookdeck_retry_event, hookdeck_list_requests

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
